name: Clorinde
notes: An Electro main DPS. Both sources put the Skill first (Hunter's Vigil raises her Surging Blades, 43.2% ATK at level 1), so the damage talent is the Skill with the elemental table; her Normal Attacks are on the physical curve, but neither source levels them first. They agree on 4pc Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy, 4pc Thundering Fury second, ATK% Sands, Electro DMG Goblet, a crit Circlet and the weapons Absolution, Haran Geppaku Futsu and The Black Sword. Goals are Game8's: ATK 1,800-2,000 or above, CR 70-80%, CD 160% or above, ER 110-130% (upper ends); KQM gives ER 110-130% for a solo Electro build with the Burst every other rotation. The third set is KQM's.
